title: Quenched Italian Fern Cake
description: A briny, cheese‑pull one‑pot Sicilian cake made with fernbrake‑gosari and double‑rise batter, finished in a single pan for a vegan-friendly torta‑caprese.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and nutritional yeast, stirring until evenly mixed.
Create a small well in the center, pour in warm water, olive oil, and salted soy sauce, and stir until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
While the dough rises, heat a skillet over medium heat and sauté the chopped fernbrake-gosari for 4 minutes until tender.
Once the dough has doubled, punch it down and fold in the sautéed fernbrake-gosari, fresh basil, and dried oregano, mixing until evenly distributed.
Transfer the dough to a greased cast‑iron skillet, shape it into a thick oval, and cover with a lid.
Cook the cake on low heat for 25 minutes, then remove the lid, sprinkle shredded vegan mozzarella over the top, and return to the heat for an additional 5 minutes until the cheese pulls.
Turn off the heat and let the cake rest for 10 minutes to set the cheese pull.
Slice the cake into wedges and serve warm as a savory dinner dish.
